help.title: 📖 **DUELLIUM HELP**
help.summary:
🧙 Wizard: `!profile`, `!house <house>`, `!train <stat>`
⚔️ Duel: `!duel @player`, `!accept`, `!decline`
🛡️ Reactions: `!protego`, `!expelliarmus`, `!dodge`
📚 Spells: `!spellbook`, `!spell <name>`, `!learn <name>`, `!answer A/B/C/D`, `!cancellearn`
🤝 Training: `!teach @student <spell>`, `!askhelp @teacher <spell>`, `!training`, `!canceltraining`
🏆 Rankings: `!leaderboard`, `!globalleaderboard`, `!houseleaderboard`
🌐 Language: `!language`, `!setlanguage en/fr` (Manage Server or bot owner)
Use `!help <command>` for usage.

spell.description.expelliarmus: A disarming spell that can also counter incoming magic.
spell.description.stupefy: A combat spell focused on control and interruption.
spell.description.incendio: A fast fire spell (Spell Speed 9) with sustained burn damage.
spell.description.diffindo: A fast offensive spell designed to pressure Dodge.
spell.description.depulso: A control spell built around interruption and displacement.
spell.description.glacius: Reduces the opponent's Speed by 5 for 10 seconds when it lands.
spell.description.petrificustotalus: Deals light damage and stuns the opponent for 4 seconds.
spell.description.bombarda: A heavy offensive spell. A successful Protego still takes 25% of its direct damage, rounded down.
spell.description.sectumsempra: A cutting curse with heavy damage and bleeding. A successful Protego prevents bleeding but still takes 25% of direct damage, rounded down; strong shields or counters can cause backlash.
spell.description.endoloris: Initial d6 roll: 3–6 succeeds, 1–2 misses. No immediate damage. A hit causes 14 damage at 3, 6, and 9 seconds over a 10-second curse.
spell.description.impero: Initial d6 roll: 4–6 succeeds, 1–3 misses. Forces the victim's highest-level learned offensive spell against themselves, with a fresh 10-second defense window. Never selects Avada Kedavra or Impero.
spell.description.avadakedavra: The ultimate Killing Curse. If it lands, the opponent is defeated instantly.
